name: Bulbasaur
bio: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
bio: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

name: Venusaur
bio: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

name: Charmander
bio: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
bio: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Charizard
bio: If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

name: Squirtle
bio: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
bio: Wartortle’s long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular among older people.

name: Blastoise
bio: It deliberately increases its body weight so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

name: Caterpie
bio: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
bio: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

name: Butterfree
bio: It loves the nectar of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

name: Weedle
bio: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

name: Kakuna
bio: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

name: Beedrill
bio: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Pidgey
bio: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

name: Pidgeotto
bio: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgeot
bio: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

name: Rattata
bio: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Raticate
bio: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Spearow
bio: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
bio: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

name: Ekans
bio: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

name: Arbok
bio: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Pikachu
bio: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu
bio: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Sandshrew
bio: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

name: Sandslash
bio: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

name: Nidoran♀
bio: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

name: Nidorina
bio: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.

name: Nidoqueen
bio: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

name: Nidoran♂
bio: The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

name: Nidorino
bio: With a horn that’s harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

name: Nidoking
bio: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

name: Clefairy
bio: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

name: Clefable
bio: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.

name: Vulpix
bio: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

name: Ninetales
bio: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

name: Jigglypuff
bio: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
bio: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Zubat
bio: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
bio: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

name: Oddish
bio: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

name: Gloom
bio: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
bio: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

name: Paras
bio: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

name: Parasect
bio: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.

name: Venonat
bio: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

name: Venomoth
bio: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Diglett
bio: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
bio: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Meowth
bio: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
bio: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Psyduck
bio: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
bio: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Mankey
bio: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
bio: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

name: Growlithe
bio: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
bio: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Poliwag
bio: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It appears more clearly after Poliwag eats.

name: Poliwhirl
bio: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Poliwrath
bio: Although it’s skilled in a style of dynamic swimming that uses all its muscles, for some reason it lives on dry land.

name: Abra
bio: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
bio: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam
bio: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Machop
bio: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
bio: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
bio: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

name: Bellsprout
bio: No matter what Bellsprout is doing, if it detects movement nearby, it will immediately react by reaching out with its thin vines.

name: Weepinbell
bio: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Victreebel
bio: It lures prey into its mouth with a nectar-like aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

name: Tentacool
bio: When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool can be found left behind on the shore.

name: Tentacruel
bio: On the rare occasions that large outbreaks of Tentacruel occur, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.

name: Geodude
bio: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: Graveler
bio: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.

name: Golem
bio: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

name: Ponyta
bio: About an hour after birth, Ponyta’s fiery mane and tail grow out, giving the Pokémon an impressive appearance.

name: Rapidash
bio: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Slowpoke
bio: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
bio: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Magnemite
bio: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
bio: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Farfetch'd
bio: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Doduo
bio: Its twin heads have exactly the same genes and battle in perfect sync with each other.

name: Dodrio
bio: It now has three hearts and three sets of lungs. Though it can’t run as fast as Doduo, Dodrio can keep running for longer stretches of time.

name: Seel
bio: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
bio: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

name: Grimer
bio: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
bio: It’s thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Shellder
bio: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
bio: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Gastly
bio: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
bio: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
bio: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Onix
bio: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Drowzee
bio: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

name: Hypno
bio: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Krabby
bio: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler
bio: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

name: Voltorb
bio: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
bio: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Exeggcute
bio: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

name: Exeggutor
bio: It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

name: Cubone
bio: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
bio: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Hitmonlee
bio: At the exact moment it lands a kick on its target, Hitmonlee hardens the muscles on the sole of its foot, maximizing the power of the kick.

name: Hitmonchan
bio: It corners its foes with combo punches from both sides, then finishes them off with a single straight punch launched at over 300 mph.

name: Lickitung
bio: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

name: Koffing
bio: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Weezing
bio: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.

name: Rhyhorn
bio: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

name: Rhydon
bio: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

name: Chansey
bio: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Tangela
bio: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Kangaskhan
bio: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Horsea
bio: If attacked—even by a large enemy—Horsea effortlessly swims to safety by utilizing its well-developed dorsal fin.

name: Seadra
bio: The male raises the young. If it is approached while caring for young, it will use its toxic spines to fend off the intruder.

name: Goldeen
bio: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

name: Seaking
bio: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Staryu
bio: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
bio: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Mr. Mime
bio: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

name: Scyther
bio: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Jynx
bio: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Electabuzz
bio: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

name: Magmar
bio: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Pinsir
bio: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Tauros
bio: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Magikarp
bio: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
bio: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lapras
bio: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

name: Ditto
bio: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.

name: Eevee
bio: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Vaporeon
bio: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Jolteon
bio: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Flareon
bio: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
bio: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

name: Omanyte
bio: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

name: Omastar
bio: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

name: Kabuto
bio: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

name: Kabutops
bio: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

name: Aerodactyl
bio: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

name: Snorlax
bio: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it’s asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

name: Articuno
bio: This legendary bird Pokémon can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Zapdos
bio: This legendary Pokémon is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Moltres
bio: It is one of the legendary bird Pokémon. Its appearance is said to indicate the coming of spring.

name: Dratini
bio: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
bio: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Dragonite
bio: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

name: Mewtwo
bio: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mew
bio: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
